Lismore, Co. Waterford

Residential Site | Approx. 0.84 Acres | Subject to Planning Permission

Denise Radley Auctioneers are delighted to present this attractive residential site extending to approximately 0.84 acres, ideally situated in the scenic countryside of Bawnmore, Lismore, Co. Waterford.

The site enjoys a peaceful rural setting while remaining exceptionally convenient, located approximately 5 minutes from Lismore and 7 minutes from Cappoquin. This provides easy access to schools, shops, sporting facilities and a wide range of everyday amenities.

Bawnmore is situated in the beautiful Blackwater Valley, an area renowned for its picturesque countryside and proximity to the River Blackwater, famous for its salmon and trout fishing. The locality also benefits from a strong community spirit, making it particularly attractive for those wishing to establish a family home in a rural yet well-connected setting.

The site is situated adjacent to Eircode P51 RX93 and offers an excellent opportunity for a purchaser wishing to design and build their own home, subject to obtaining the necessary planning permission.

The heritage town of Lismore is just a short drive away and offers an excellent range of amenities including primary and secondary schools, shops, cafés, sporting facilities, walking trails and community organisations. Cappoquin is also within easy reach, while Dungarvan, Fermoy and Clonmel are all accessible for commuting.

This is an excellent opportunity to acquire a generously sized site in a particularly attractive part of West Waterford, combining countryside living, a strong local community and convenient access to nearby towns.

Features include: approx. 0.84-acre site; for sale subject to planning permission; approx. 5 minutes from Lismore and 7 minutes from Cappoquin; situated in the scenic Blackwater Valley; close to the River Blackwater and renowned fishing; strong local community; convenient to primary and secondary schools; beautiful rural surroundings; adjacent to Eircode P51 RX93; and within commuting distance of Dungarvan, Fermoy and Clonmel.

Subject to the purchaser obtaining planning permission.

For further information or to arrange a viewing, please contact Denise Radley Auctioneers.
